title: The Frugal Wizard's Handbook for Surviving Medieval England
author: Brandon Sanderson
summary: A comic fantasy that drops a modern-day man into medieval England, where getting by takes more than he expected. It is a light, playful adventure from an author better known for very long epics.
readIf: you want a funny, fast fantasy adventure that does not ask for a big commitment.
skipIf: you want the vast scale and depth of the author's longer fantasy epics.

pairings.reason: A fantasy adventure that loves jokes and treats the whole thing as a good story told with a grin.
Another quick-witted fantasy with an ordinary person caught up in the extraordinary.
More light-hearted Sanderson, a sweet, funny quest with a likeable narrator.
